title: William R NDE 232
content: My father was an alcoholic and quite violent. My mother would support his violence. I felt trapped. I tried running away, but was always caught. My life was falling apart and I knew of no direction to turn so, I turned to suicide. My mother was a Registered Nurse and kept a drawer full of many types of pills. I took them all and washed them down with my father's beer and whiskey. I was discovered the next evening on the floor and not expected to live. They gave me a tracheotomy and took me to Los Angeles Community Hospital. While on the operating table, I found myself in a dark corner of the room looking down at myself lying there. I was able to float down to the body and look up at the doctor and nurses who were in the process of pronouncing me dead. I saw them put a tag on my big toe. When I looked into their faces they looked so beautiful, their skin so soft and pink, their eyes so full of love. I felt very emotional, realizing what I had done, and how wrong it was. My life flashed before me, including every minute detail. Then I felt myself being pulled up a tube, or more like inside a blood vessel. All around me were other life forms being pulled up. I could see the end of the tube and it shined very brightly with white light. I kept going faster and faster until I flew out the end into space. There were stars all around, a groaning sound, I was cold, and I felt absolute bliss. I had a body, but it didn't have definition; a hand, but no fingers; legs and feet, but no toes. Somehow I was drawn to this area where I could see life forms of all kinds, some even looked like elephants. They kept passing in front of me until a dark haired human being stopped in front of me and introduced himself as my entrance into the records of all time, everything that has ever happened, or is going to happen. The library of all existing knowledge for all of God's creatures. He shared all kinds of information with me, and even let me see other lifetimes I will be experiencing. I was given the choice to leave life on earth and continue on, or, he recommended I return to earth and complete this life cycle. He said it was important to complete each lifetime and its teachings before going on. After three months in a coma, I returned to my body instantaneously, and it hurt like hell. I woke up, but was unable to see for about a week. I couldn't speak because of the tracheotomy. I could hear but it was echo-like. I was a mess.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Pulled up a tube, "more like inside a blood vessel."

arrival.other_being_detail: Many "life forms" (some looked like elephants) and a dark-haired human being who introduced himself as William's "entrance into the records of all time."

environment.environment_other_detail: Flew out of the tube "into space" with stars all around; heard a "groaning sound"; felt cold; experienced "absolute bliss."

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He recommended returning to earth to "complete this life cycle" and that it was important to complete each lifetime and its teachings before going on.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Overdose on many pills plus beer and whiskey; found next evening; tracheotomy; on operating table.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encountered many non-human "life forms" and accessed "records of all time" / a library of all knowledge.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE and observation of being pronounced dead occurred before the life review; then tube/tunnel with bright light; then space/other realm with beings and knowledge; then return choice and return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Other life forms were being pulled up the tube; in the realm he saw diverse life forms (some like elephants). A being introduced himself as an "entrance into the records of all time" and showed a "library of all existing knowledge" and "other lifetimes" he would experience.

I saw them put a tag on my big toe."; "My life flashed before me, including every minute detail."; "pulled up a tube, or more like inside a blood vessel"; "it shined very brightly with white light"; "I flew out the end into space"; "I felt absolute bliss"; "the records of all time"; "complete this life cycle"; "I returned to my body instantaneously, and it hurt like hell."
